summary: Duration::checked_div previously guarded only against division by zero. Duration::MIN.checked_div(-1) therefore attempted i64::MIN / -1 and panicked on overflow instead of returning None. The fix uses checked integer division and propagates None through const_try_opt!. The commit adds the detecting assertion to duration::checked_div. The proposed reversal restores only the original function implementation; both regions occur exactly once in their respective Git versions. No builds or tests were run.
